note: Per-district portfolio aggregates for the 273 study districts (76 BIDs, 197 campuses). Membership = footprint centroid inside the district polygon. BID/campus boundaries are administrative study areas — NOT evidence of shared heating/cooling infrastructure. EUI/GFA aggregates keep LL84's property-level grain: a campus row may roll several buildings into one reporting property. Thermal totals are modeled, not measured.
